choice: SidebarService.tick wraps every poll, prints the traceback in the server tab and shows a banner. LinearClient.query turns unreadable answers into LinearError, and 'Entity not found' becomes LinearNotFound, so an issue lookup no longer hides network errors.
context: A code review found that the poller caught only CmuxError and LinearError: an unexpected Linear answer (a non-JSON body, IncompleteRead, null data) killed the thread and froze the page on stale data while the HTTP server kept serving it.
rejected: Catching only the two expected error types in the tick.
title: The poller thread must survive any exception
